_comment: Real Huawei AMF. Every field below (except ran_node_name/nci) MUST match what the Huawei AMF has provisioned for this gNB, or NG Setup is REJECTED. Confirm mcc/mnc/tac/sst/sd/gnb_id with the AMF operator BEFORE running. The AMF also usually whitelists the gNB source IP: run 'sctp-ping' to see which source IP the AMF sees, and have that IP provisioned.
